R1.name: Residence 1
R1.housing: One-family homes, plus one small apartment inside a home (up to one bedroom or 500 sq ft). No duplexes or apartment buildings.
notes: Minimum lot 12,000 sq ft (§19-502.a)
Building footprint capped at 30% of small lots (§19-502.g)

R2.name: Residence 2
R2.housing: One-family and two-family homes, and student homes. Apartment buildings are not listed.
notes: Minimum lot 10,000 sq ft for one-family, 20,000 sq ft for two-family (§19-602(a))
Building footprint capped at 30% of small lots (§19-602(f))

R3.name: Residence 3
R3.housing: Apartment buildings allowed, at about one home per 2,000 sq ft of lot (row dwellings capped at six units in a row).
notes: Minimum lot area 2,000 sq ft per apartment (§19-702(a))
Dwellings limited to two stories (§19-703)

R3H.name: Residence 3H (historic)
R3H.height_note: §19-954; new buildings must also fit within 30% of the average height next door
R3H.housing: Uses allowed in R-2: one-family and two-family homes.
notes: Minimum lot 6,000 sq ft one-family, 9,000 sq ft two-family (§19-953(a))
One main building per lot, 3,000 sq ft gross floor area cap (§19-955, §19-956)

R4.name: Residence 4
R4.height_note: §19-1003(a); 65 ft in an area west of S. Atherton St
R4.housing: Apartment buildings allowed, at about one home per 500 sq ft of lot.
notes: Minimum lot area 500 sq ft per apartment (§19-1002(a))
Taller buildings by special exception, never above 85 ft (§19-1003(b)(7))

RO.name: Residence Office
RO.housing: Apartment buildings allowed (via R-3 uses), at about one home per 1,000 sq ft of lot. Offices also allowed.
notes: Minimum lot area 1,000 sq ft per apartment (§19-1102a)
Multi-family side yards 15 ft (§19-1102d)

RO-A.name: Residence Office A
RO-A.height_note: §19-1156; new buildings must also fit within 30% of the average height next door
RO-A.housing: Uses allowed in R-2, plus three-family homes (two bedrooms or fewer each). Offices allowed.
notes: One residential building per lot (§19-1155)
Buildings may cover up to 40% of the lot (§19-1153(f))

C.name: Commercial (downtown)
C.height_note: §19-1804.b; 45 ft and four stories in specified core areas (§19-1804.a)
C.housing: Apartments allowed on upper floors. Housing on the ground floor is barred along listed downtown streets (§19-1802.h).
notes: Residential floor area capped at 2.0 to 3.0 times the lot, depending on location (§19-1803.f)
Drive-throughs by conditional use, new gas stations barred (§19-1806)
Overlays can allow far more height (Collegiate Housing, Incentives, Conditional Use)

CID.name: Commercial Incentive District
CID.height_note: Base §19-1852; up to 95 ft with incentives (§19-1855(c))
CID.housing: Housing allowed above the ground floor (ground-floor housing allowed west of Atherton St).
notes: Residential floor area 2.0 times the lot, up to 3.0 with incentives (§19-1851(f), §19-1855(c))
Motor-vehicle-oriented businesses prohibited (§19-1850(a))

CP1.name: Planned Commercial 1
CP1.housing: Housing allowed through R-3 uses, at about one apartment per 2,000 sq ft of lot.
notes: Gasoline sales and drive-in restaurants prohibited (§19-1401.c, .j)
Buildings may cover up to 35% of the lot (§19-1402.c(1))

CP2.name: Planned Commercial 2
CP2.housing: Appears allowed through the CP-1 and R-3 cross-references (§19-1501(a), §19-1401(a)). A hotel-with-apartments plan was reviewed for a nearby lot in 2020 and 2021 (later withdrawn). Confirm with planning staff.
notes: Uses allowed in CP-1 and C districts, with exceptions (§19-1501(a),(b))
Motels allowed where the lot fronts a state highway (§19-1501(e)(1))
Motor-vehicle-oriented business is a conditional use (§19-1501(e)(3)); the C-district rules bar new gas stations (§19-1806.a(3)). Planning staff need to confirm how these fit together.
Drive-throughs are conditional uses (§19-1806)

CP3.name: Planned Commercial 3
CP3.housing: Housing allowed in mixed-use buildings, never on the ground floor (§19-1511(c)).
notes: Minimum lot 14,000 sq ft (§19-1512(a))
Apartments need 1,750 sq ft of lot each (two bedrooms or fewer)

UV.name: Urban Village
UV.height_note: §19-1927(d)(2); 65 ft within 75 ft of the northern boundary
UV.housing: Housing allowed (R-O uses and residential mixed use), one residential building per lot.
notes: Buildings cover at most 25% of the lot (§19-1927(a)(1))
Motor fuel sales prohibited (§19-1926(a))
